shadowSentences: I like to cook on weekends.
Traveling opens up new experiences for me.
Listening to music helps me relax after work.
I often go hiking in the mountains nearby.
Gardening has become a peaceful hobby for me.
I find photography a wonderful way to capture moments.
Volunteering at the local shelter is very rewarding.
Writing in a journal helps me reflect on my day.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: What are some typical foods you eat daily?
Q2: Have you ever faced challenges in maintaining a healthy diet?
Q3: How do you feel about the importance of nutrition in our lives?
Q4: What advice would you give someone trying to eat healthier?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about pet care.
questions: Q1: Can you tell me about any pets you have owned?
Q2: What challenges have you encountered while caring for pets?
Q3: In your opinion, what makes a good pet owner?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to new pet owners?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: What steps do you take to be more environmentally friendly?
Q2: Have you faced any obstacles in reducing your carbon footprint?
Q3: What is your opinion on climate change and its effects?
Q4: What advice would you offer to someone wanting to live sustainably?
